archive.catalogue_description: Description hi that’s another map, the map offers runner zombies with custom zombie skins. Start room has thompson semi auto rate of fire on the wall. The power switch is in hidden room, which you will have to find this. Buy-able ending is also hidden until power is turned on for 50k the features are: dogs custom zombie skins pack a punch the four drinks guns on the wall treasure chest changed fire type to some guns ( thompson semi auto, m1 carabine automatic and colt automatic) buyable ending zombie risers and non risers power secret room and some more things…

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3). PROVISIONAL: archive/corpus-ignore.json was missing, so corpus boilerplate was not subtracted and this finish may be a shared-script name; scan_maps.py --keep-existing rewrites this manifest.
